audience: teams that run IoT devices on the Particle device cloud

useCases.title: Find devices that are offline
useCases.text: List the devices your account can see, newest handshake first, with their online status. Filter one product's devices by name or serial number.

useCases.title: Read a sensor value from a device
useCases.text: Get one device to see the variables and functions it exposes. Read the current value of one variable, such as a temperature.

useCases.title: Check the access token and the account
useCases.text: Read the signed-in account and its device counts. Check when the access token expires and which scopes it has.

useCases.title: Call a device function
useCases.text: Call a function that the device exposes, with one optional text argument of up to 63 characters. The result depends on the device code.

useCases.title: Rename a device
useCases.text: Set a new name for a device. Renaming a device to the same name changes nothing.
